description: This file manages global application state related to database configuration and session management. It provides functions to set and retrieve singleton instances of configuration objects, engine, and sessionmaker, facilitating dependency injection in the application.

methods.name: None set_state(settings: Settings, engine: Engine, session_local: sessionmaker)
methods.description: Stores provided settings, engine, and sessionmaker as global singleton instances for application-wide dependency injection.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton Settings instance, raises RuntimeError if not initialized.

methods.name: Engine get_engine()
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton SQLAlchemy Engine instance, raises RuntimeError if not initialized.

methods.name: sessionmaker get_sessionmaker()
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton sessionmaker instance, raises RuntimeError if not initialized.

ctags.name: set_state
ctags.pattern: /^def set_state(settings: Settings, engine: Engine, session_local: sessionmaker) -> None:$/
